jobDescription: Frontend Engineer, 3-5 years experience, React, Redux, Webpack.
transcript:
AI: Tell me about a time you optimized a React app.
CANDIDATE: I used React.memo and useMemo to prevent unnecessary re-renders in a large data table. I also code-split the routes using React.lazy.
AI: How does virtual DOM work?
CANDIDATE: It's an in-memory representation of the real DOM. React diffs it with the previous version and batches updates to the real DOM.
